title_zh: Science and technology — 第19节可背诵讲义
body_en: Science and technology help us solve problems, but they need careful people. Check facts before you believe a message online. In lab work, follow safety rules and write clear results. A good invention saves time or protects people — say which one you care about most.
body_zh: 科技帮我们解决问题，但需要谨慎的人。网上信息先核实再相信。实验课遵守安全规则，写清结果。好发明能省时间或保护人——说说你最在意哪一种。
